fruits.extendedStory: This was the north gate of a Roman camp called Castra Regina. It went up under the emperor Marcus Aurelius, on the south bank of the Danube. The Third Italian Legion was stationed here, sent in answer to the Marcomannic Wars. Of all the Roman gates once built north of the Alps, this is the only one still standing.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Dies war das Nordtor eines römischen Lagers namens Castra Regina. Es entstand unter Kaiser Marcus Aurelius, am Südufer der Donau. Hier lag die Dritte Italische Legion, hergeschickt wegen der Markomannenkriege. Von allen römischen Toren nördlich der Alpen steht heute nur noch dieses.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This was the north gate of a Roman camp called Castra Regina. It went up under the emperor Marcus Aurelius, on the south bank of the Danube. The Third Italian Legion was stationed here, sent in answer to the Marcomannic Wars. Of all the Roman gates once built north of the Alps, this is the only one still standing.

localizedStory.de: Geh unter der Porta praetoria hindurch: Dieses Steintor bauten die Römer schon im Jahr 179. Über achtzehn Jahrhunderte alt.
localizedStory.en: Duck under the Porta praetoria. A stone gate Roman builders raised in the year 179, still standing more than eighteen centuries later.

fruits.name: Porta praetoria
fruits.story: Duck under the Porta praetoria. A stone gate Roman builders raised in the year 179, still standing more than eighteen centuries later.

fruits.extendedStory: The kitchen has stood over 500 years beside the Steinerne Brücke, right at the Donaustrudel. Stonemasons ate here in the Middle Ages, and so did the men who worked the river boats. They wanted the same thing you can smell now. The same smell has drifted along this lane for centuries.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Küche steht seit über 500 Jahren neben der Steinernen Brücke, direkt am Donaustrudel. Schon im Mittelalter aßen hier Steinmetze und die Männer, die am Hafen arbeiteten. Sie wollten genau dasselbe, was du jetzt hier riechst. Derselbe Duft zieht seit Jahrhunderten durch diese Gasse.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The kitchen has stood over 500 years beside the Steinerne Brücke, right at the Donaustrudel. Stonemasons ate here in the Middle Ages, and so did the men who worked the river boats. They wanted the same thing you can smell now. The same smell has drifted along this lane for centuries.

localizedStory.de: Folg deiner Nase zur Weiße-Lamm-Gasse. In einer winzigen Küche brutzeln dort die Würste über dem Feuer.
localizedStory.en: The Historische Wurstkuchl is a tiny 'sausage kitchen'. Follow your nose to Weiße-Lamm-Gasse and watch the sausages sizzle on the grill.

fruits.name: Historische Wurstkuchl
fruits.story: The Historische Wurstkuchl is a tiny 'sausage kitchen'. Follow your nose to Weiße-Lamm-Gasse and watch the sausages sizzle on the grill.

fruits.extendedStory: Work on the cathedral started in 1275, and the building was not counted as finished until 1520. It is Gothic, so the windows rise in points and the stone is cut fine as lace. Much later Franz Joseph Denzinger took the work in hand and carried it on. The church is named for Saint Peter.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vom Baubeginn bis zur Vollendung vergingen Jahrhunderte, von 1275 bis 1520. Die Gotik erkennst du an den spitzen Fenstern und am Stein, der fein wie Spitze gearbeitet ist. Franz Joseph Denzinger nahm die Arbeit viel später wieder auf und führte sie zu Ende. Der Dom trägt den Namen des heiligen Petrus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Work on the cathedral started in 1275, and the building was not counted as finished until 1520. It is Gothic, so the windows rise in points and the stone is cut fine as lace. Much later Franz Joseph Denzinger took the work in hand and carried it on. The church is named for Saint Peter.

localizedStory.de: Auf dem Domplatz lohnt der Blick nach oben. Die beiden Turmspitzen des Doms erreichen 105 Meter. Feiner Stein bis hinauf in die Wolken.
localizedStory.en: Stand on Domplatz and look up. The cathedral's twin spires climb 105 m into the sky, stone lace against the clouds.

fruits.name: Dom Sankt Peter
fruits.story: Stand on Domplatz and look up. The cathedral's twin spires climb 105 m into the sky, stone lace against the clouds.

fruits.extendedStory: Before it was a palace it was an abbey. The Imperial Abbey of Sankt Emmeram stood here, one of the largest Benedictine monasteries in Germany. The princely house of Thurn und Taxis took it over and made it their home. Jean-Baptiste Métivier shaped much of what you see today. It holds well over 500 rooms, which makes it the largest privately inhabited castle.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Bevor es ein Schloss war, war es eine Abtei. Hier stand die Reichsabtei Sankt Emmeram, eines der größten Benediktinerklöster Deutschlands. Das Fürstenhaus Thurn und Taxis übernahm sie und machte sie zu seinem Zuhause. Jean-Baptiste Métivier prägte vieles von dem, was du heute siehst. Es hat weit über 500 Zimmer und ist damit das größte privat bewohnte Schloss.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Before it was a palace it was an abbey. The Imperial Abbey of Sankt Emmeram stood here, one of the largest Benedictine monasteries in Germany. The princely house of Thurn und Taxis took it over and made it their home. Jean-Baptiste Métivier shaped much of what you see today. It holds well over 500 rooms, which makes it the largest privately inhabited castle.

localizedStory.de: Tritt in den Schlosshof ein, den Innenhof von Schloss St. Emmeram: Hier umgibt dich ein echtes Schloss von allen Seiten.
localizedStory.en: Step into the Schlosshof, the courtyard of Schloss St. Emmeram. A real palace wraps around you on every side.

fruits.name: Schloss St. Emmeram
fruits.story: Step into the Schlosshof, the courtyard of Schloss St. Emmeram. A real palace wraps around you on every side.

fruits.extendedStory: This was one of six gate towers that once guarded the old city wall. Five storeys of Gothic stone rise straight above the road. Look at the wall beside the arch and find the long slots cut into the stone. A portcullis once dropped down those slots on chains, let go from the floor above.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Sechs solcher Tortürme schützten früher die Stadtmauer, dieser ist einer davon. Fünf Geschosse gotischer Stein ragen hier über die Straße. Schau an der Mauer neben dem Bogen und such die langen Schlitze darin. An Ketten wurde dort früher ein Gitter heruntergelassen, von oben aus dem Turm.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This was one of six gate towers that once guarded the old city wall. Five storeys of Gothic stone rise straight above the road. Look at the wall beside the arch and find the long slots cut into the stone. A portcullis once dropped down those slots on chains, let go from the floor above.

localizedStory.de: Geh durch das Ostentor, Regensburgs altes Osttor: Seine Türme bewachen diesen Weg schon seit 1284. Über sieben Jahrhunderte lang.
localizedStory.en: Walk through the Ostentor, Regensburg's old east gate. Its towers have watched this road since 1284, more than seven centuries.

fruits.name: Ostentor
fruits.story: Walk through the Ostentor, Regensburg's old east gate. Its towers have watched this road since 1284, more than seven centuries.

fruits.extendedStory: An iron bridge stood here from 1863. It was destroyed in April 1945, and the crossing fell back on wood. That makeshift bridge carried people from 1946 all the way to 1991. The bridge under your feet was built between 1988 and 1991, to a design by Auer and Weber. It runs 82 metres long and 16 metres wide.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Eine eiserne Brücke stand hier ab 1863. Im April 1945 wurde sie zerstört, und der Übergang behalf sich mit Holz. Diese Behelfsbrücke trug die Leute von 1946 bis 1991. Die Brücke unter deinen Füßen entstand zwischen 1988 und 1991, nach einem Entwurf von Auer und Weber. Sie misst 82 Meter in der Länge und 16 in der Breite.
localizedExtendedStory.en: An iron bridge stood here from 1863. It was destroyed in April 1945, and the crossing fell back on wood. That makeshift bridge carried people from 1946 all the way to 1991. The bridge under your feet was built between 1988 and 1991, to a design by Auer and Weber. It runs 82 metres long and 16 metres wide.

localizedStory.de: Geh über die Eiserne Brücke: Metall unter den Füßen, das seit 1991 die beiden Flussufer zusammenhält.
localizedStory.en: Cross the Eiserne Brücke. Its name means 'iron bridge', and metal has linked the two banks here since 1991.

fruits.name: Eiserne Brücke
fruits.story: Cross the Eiserne Brücke. Its name means 'iron bridge', and metal has linked the two banks here since 1991.

fruits.extendedStory: The museum lives in the old friary of St. Salvator. Minorite brothers once had their cloister here. The collection was founded in 1931, but nobody could visit until 1949. Walter Boll opened the doors that year. One treasure is a model of the town as it stood around 1700. It was made in 1930, at a scale of 1 to 4000.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Museum wohnt im alten Kloster St. Salvator. Hier hatten einst Minoriten ihren Kreuzgang. Gegründet wurde die Sammlung 1931, doch besuchen konnte man sie ab 1949. In jenem Jahr öffnete Walter Boll die Türen. Ein Schatz ist ein Modell der Stadt, wie sie um 1700 dastand. Es entstand 1930 im Maßstab 1 zu 4000.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The museum lives in the old friary of St. Salvator. Minorite brothers once had their cloister here. The collection was founded in 1931, but nobody could visit until 1949. Walter Boll opened the doors that year. One treasure is a model of the town as it stood around 1700. It was made in 1930, at a scale of 1 to 4000.

localizedStory.de: Das Historische Museum füllt ein ehemaliges Kloster am Dachauplatz. Drinnen zeigt ein Modell Regensburg, wie es um 1700 aussah.
localizedStory.en: The Historisches Museum fills a former friary on Dachauplatz. Inside, a model shows Regensburg as it looked around 1700.

fruits.name: Historisches Museum
fruits.story: The Historisches Museum fills a former friary on Dachauplatz. Inside, a model shows Regensburg as it looked around 1700.

fruits.extendedStory: A convent of Benedictine nuns stood on this ground from 983. Wolfgang, the bishop of Regensburg, founded it. In 1588 Pope Sixtus V dissolved the house. Its buildings passed to the Jesuits, who ran a college in them. What remains is the name over the square, long after both the nuns and the Jesuits were gone.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Auf diesem Boden stand ab 983 ein Kloster von Benediktinerinnen. Wolfgang, der Bischof von Regensburg, gründete es. 1588 hob Papst Sixtus V. das Stift auf. Seine Gebäude gingen an die Jesuiten, die darin ein Kolleg führten. Geblieben ist der Name über dem Platz, lange nachdem beide fort waren.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A convent of Benedictine nuns stood on this ground from 983. Wolfgang, the bishop of Regensburg, founded it. In 1588 Pope Sixtus V dissolved the house. Its buildings passed to the Jesuits, who ran a college in them. What remains is the name over the square, long after both the nuns and the Jesuits were gone.

localizedStory.de: Jesuitenplatz. Ein Platz, benannt nach den Jesuiten, der sich Am Mittelmünster öffnet. Bleib kurz stehen und schau dich um.
localizedStory.en: Jesuitenplatz. A square named for the Jesuits, opening off Am Mittelmünster. Stand a moment and look around.

fruits.name: Jesuitenplatz
fruits.story: Jesuitenplatz. A square named for the Jesuits, opening off Am Mittelmünster. Stand a moment and look around.

fruits.extendedStory: The tower goes back to the middle of the 13th century. Rich families then built their houses like small castles. It stands 55 metres high. In the hall upstairs the Perpetual Imperial Diet sat from 1663 to 1806. Envoys from across the empire came here to talk, year after year, for generations. The Gothic wooden ceiling above them is still in place.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Turm reicht bis in die Mitte des 13. Jahrhunderts zurück. Reiche Familien bauten ihre Häuser damals wie kleine Burgen. Er ist 55 Meter hoch. Im Saal darüber tagte von 1663 bis 1806 der Immerwährende Reichstag. Gesandte aus dem ganzen Reich kamen her, Jahr für Jahr, über Generationen. Die gotische Holzdecke über ihnen ist bis heute erhalten.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tower goes back to the middle of the 13th century. Rich families then built their houses like small castles. It stands 55 metres high. In the hall upstairs the Perpetual Imperial Diet sat from 1663 to 1806. Envoys from across the empire came here to talk, year after year, for generations. The Gothic wooden ceiling above them is still in place.

localizedStory.de: Neptunhof. Steig hinauf zum Alten Rathaus, wo einst der Immerwährende Reichstag tagte, das lange Parlament des Reichs.
localizedStory.en: Neptunhof. Step up to the Altes Rathaus, the old town hall where the Perpetual Imperial Diet, the empire's long parliament, once met.

fruits.name: Altes Rathaus
fruits.story: Neptunhof. Step up to the Altes Rathaus, the old town hall where the Perpetual Imperial Diet, the empire's long parliament, once met.

fruits.extendedStory: Georg Friedrich Ritter von Müller bought this ground in 1804 and laid out a private garden. It stayed private for a long time. The city bought it in 1935, and between 1950 and 1952 the garden was remade for everyone. At about 1.5 hectares it is one of the smaller parks here, with the Württembergisches Palais along its south side.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Georg Friedrich Ritter von Müller kaufte dieses Gelände 1804 und legte einen privaten Garten an. Lange blieb er privat. 1935 kaufte die Stadt das Gelände, und von 1950 bis 1952 wurde der Garten für alle umgestaltet. Mit rund 1,5 Hektar zählt er zu den kleineren Parks, an seiner Südseite steht das Württembergische Palais.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Georg Friedrich Ritter von Müller bought this ground in 1804 and laid out a private garden. It stayed private for a long time. The city bought it in 1935, and between 1950 and 1952 the garden was remade for everyone. At about 1.5 hectares it is one of the smaller parks here, with the Württembergisches Palais along its south side.

localizedStory.de: Herzogspark heißt 'Herzogs Park'. Grüne Wege zum Schlendern und eine ruhige Ecke von Regensburg zum Durchatmen.
localizedStory.en: Herzogspark means 'duke's park'. Green paths to wander and a quiet corner of Regensburg to catch your breath.

fruits.name: Herzogspark
fruits.story: Herzogspark means 'duke's park'. Green paths to wander and a quiet corner of Regensburg to catch your breath.

fruits.extendedStory: Building started in 1627, to a design by Hans Johann Carl, and the church is named for the Holy Trinity. Its tower is open, and 157 steps wind up to the platform. From up there the roofs of the old town spread out below you. Nobody is paid to run it. A team of volunteers takes turns at the top and keeps the climb open through the season.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau begann 1627 nach einem Entwurf von Hans Johann Carl, und die Kirche trägt den Namen der Heiligen Dreieinigkeit. Ihr Turm ist offen, 157 Stufen winden sich hinauf zur Plattform. Von dort oben breiten sich die Dächer der Altstadt unter dir aus. Bezahlt wird dafür niemand. Ein Team von Ehrenamtlichen wechselt sich oben ab und hält den Aufstieg über die Saison offen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Building started in 1627, to a design by Hans Johann Carl, and the church is named for the Holy Trinity. Its tower is open, and 157 steps wind up to the platform. From up there the roofs of the old town spread out below you. Nobody is paid to run it. A team of volunteers takes turns at the top and keeps the climb open through the season.

localizedStory.de: Der Turm hier hat 157 Stufen, und ehrenamtliche Turmaufseher halten den Aufstieg über die Saison offen.
localizedStory.en: The tower here has 157 steps, and a team of volunteers keeps the climb open through the season.

fruits.name: Dreieinigkeitskirche
fruits.story: The tower here has 157 steps, and a team of volunteers keeps the climb open through the season.

fruits.extendedStory: Carl Schad drew this church, and his day job was chief building officer to the house of Thurn und Taxis. The foundation stone went down in July 1929. Bishop Michael Buchberger consecrated the finished church in November 1930. Look at its shape: a strict cube under a saddle roof, built in a late-Expressionist style.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Carl Schad entwarf diese Kirche, im Hauptberuf war er Thurn und Taxischer Oberbaurat. Im Juli 1929 wurde der Grundstein gelegt. Im November 1930 weihte Bischof Michael Buchberger den fertigen Bau. Achte auf die Form: ein strenger Kubus unter einem Satteldach, spätexpressionistisch gebaut.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Carl Schad drew this church, and his day job was chief building officer to the house of Thurn und Taxis. The foundation stone went down in July 1929. Bishop Michael Buchberger consecrated the finished church in November 1930. Look at its shape: a strict cube under a saddle roof, built in a late-Expressionist style.

localizedStory.de: An der Kreuzgasse steht Herz Jesu. Diese Kirche entstand 1928 und ist damit viel jünger als die Gassen ringsum.
localizedStory.en: Herz Jesu church has risen over Kreuzgasse since 1928. Young stone among Regensburg's ancient lanes.

fruits.name: Herz Jesu
fruits.story: Herz Jesu church has risen over Kreuzgasse since 1928. Young stone among Regensburg's ancient lanes.
